name: Acetildenafil
summary: An RC analogue of sildenafil (viagra) often missold as a hidden ingredient in many 'natural' sexual potency blends and supplements.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Acetildenafil (hongdenafil) is a synthetic drug which acts as a phosphodiesterase inhibitor.

uses.text: It is an analog of sildenafil (Viagra) which has been detected in numerous different brands of "herbal aphrodisiac" products sold in convenience stores that claim to boost libido and alleviate erectile dysfunction.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class cause headache, flushing, indigestion, a blocked nose and changes in vision. They lower blood pressure, which is dangerous for people with heart disease, and hidden doses in supplements mean people take them unknowingly.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的藥物會引起頭痛、臉部潮紅、消化不良、鼻塞與視覺改變。它們會降低血壓，對心臟病患者而言很危險；而補充品中隱藏的成分，更意味著人們在不知情的情況下服用。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的药物会引起头痛、脸部潮红、消化不良、鼻塞与视觉改变。它们会降低血压，对心脏病患者而言很危险；而补充品中隐藏的成分，更意味着人们在不知情的情况下服用。

fact.en: Sildenafil was discovered by accident: it was being tested for angina when trial volunteers reported an unexpected side effect. Acetildenafil is a close copy that has been slipped into herbal supplements.
fact.zh: 西地那非（sildenafil）是意外發現的：當時它正在測試治療心絞痛，而試驗參與者報告了出乎意料的副作用。乙醯地那非是它的近似仿製品，曾被偷偷加進草本補充品中。
fact.zhHans: 西地那非（sildenafil）是意外发现的：当时它正在测试治疗心绞痛，而试验参与者报告了出乎意料的副作用。乙酰地那非是它的近似仿制品，曾被偷偷加进草本补充品中。
